# Price the retainer around your life, not an arbitrary hourly rate.

> Price a freelance retainer from capacity and costs, then see whether it still beats hourly when the client uses half the block, the full block, or more. Free and private in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
